integrity: The generator cancellation, critical-plane tangency, equilibrium discriminant, and a rational threshold instance were replayed from the packaged exact-arithmetic checker. scientific_limitations: The sharp threshold theorem is restricted to 0<a<1 and does not cover the classical large-a chaotic parameter set.
Above threshold, existence of nonzero equilibrium measures is proved, not existence of a chaotic attractor for every parameter value.
The original 2005 article was not available for full-text inspection; bibliographic and abstract material were inspected.

The 2017 energy-cycle paper already contains adjacent equilibrium-count, energy, bound, and example-specific stability results; novelty claimed here is limited to the exact stationary defect and sharp low-a global recurrence threshold.
Targeted searches cannot exclude a differently phrased or unindexed older stationary identity.
title: A sharp global recurrence threshold and stationary defect law for the Qi chaotic system
